{{Quote|Captain Needa, the ship no longer appears on our scopes.|Nemet reporting the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} apparent disappearance|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Nemet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Line Branch]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], attaining the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he served as a [[Logistics officer/Legends|logistics officer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], attached to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. While serving aboard the ''Avenger'', Nemet relayed important scanner information to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]].

Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the ''Avenger'' was charged with pursuing the fugitive [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. Nemet was aboard the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] when the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] lost track of the ''Falcon'' in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], and he reported to Needa that the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was no longer visible on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. When Vader demanded an update on the pursuit of the ''Falcon'', Needa ordered Nemet and the rest of his command crew to continue searching for the freighter before going to the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], to personally apologize for his failure&mdash;an act that would lead to the captain's [[Death/Legends|execution]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They can't have disappeared. No ship that small has a cloaking device.''"<br />"''Well, there's no trace of them, sir.|Nemet's response to Captain Needa's pondering of the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} whereabouts|audio=Needa-Nemet.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Nemet lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BTM" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> he attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]], and was a member of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Line Branch]].<ref name="CCG" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> he served as a [[Logistics officer/Legends|logistics officer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']],<ref name="CCG" /> attached to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During his service aboard the ''Avenger'', Nemet relayed important scanner information to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]],<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]].<ref name="ESB" />

In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Nemet was stationed on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] when the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was charged with pursuing the fugitive [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]&mdash;carrying Rebel fugitives [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]&mdash;through the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. During the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon'', the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at one point outmaneuvered the ''Avenger'' and caused it to almost collide with another pursuing Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]]. The ''Avenger'' chased the ''Falcon'' into the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], where the fugitive [[Starship/Legends|ship]] evaded the Star Destroyer by unknowingly taking cover in the mouth of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]] housed in one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="ESB" /> The ''Avenger'' traveled into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] to search for the ''Falcon'', where it suffered significant damage.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Eventually, the ''Millennium Falcon'' reappeared, and was spotted by the ''Avenger''. Needa had a priority signal sent to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], with the message that the ''Falcon'' was about to be captured.<ref name="ESB" />

Nemet was working in the crewpits of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} command bridge when the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] pursued the fugitive ''Falcon'' into the neighboring [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]. The freighter charged the bridge,<ref name="ESB" /> setting off alarms throughout the ''Avenger''.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Nemet, along with Needa and the rest of the command crew, dove for cover before the ''Falcon'' veered away at the last moment, and seemingly disappeared from the Star Destroyer's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Unbeknownst to Needa and his crew, the ''Millennium Falcon'' simply landed on a blind spot of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} conning tower.<ref name="ESB" /> Nemet attempted to track the ''Falcon'' on his scopes, but was unable to locate it.<ref name="ESB novel" /> He reported to Needa that the ''Falcon'' was not visible on the Star Destroyer's sensors, and Needa dismissed the idea that the freighter could have disappeared, dispelling the idea that a ship that size could have a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], to which Nemet replied there was no trace of the ''Falcon''. [[Standard second|Seconds]] later, [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] reported that [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader demanded an update on the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Needa decided to personally apologize to the Dark Lord for the failure, and ordered a [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle]] to be prepared for his visit to the ''Executor''. Needa gave one last request for his crew to continue their search for the ''Falcon'', before traveling to the ''Executor'' to rendezvous with Vader, who ultimately [[Death/Legends|executed]] the captain for his failure.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We're going to collide!|A panicked Nemet, upon seeing the ''Millennium Falcon'' heading straight towards the ''Avenger''|<ref name="ESB novel" />}}
Like many Imperials,<ref name="BTM" /> Nemet was fiercely competitive.<ref name="CCG" /> When he spotted the ''Millennium Falcon'' heading directly towards the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge, Nemet panicked and reported that the Star Destroyer was going to collide with the freighter.<ref name="ESB novel" /> The commander took cover along with Captain Needa and the rest of the command crew when the ''Falcon'' flew towards the bridge. Nemet was possessed of fair skin, as well as [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Skills and abilities==
A non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual, Nemet possessed above average intelligence and speed, and slightly above average fighting ability, diplomacy, and strength.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Commander Nemet (Imperial Officer)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569525/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-499-Commander-Nemet}}</ref>
==Equipment==
Commander Nemet wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] during his service aboard the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge<ref name="ESB" /> in 3 ABY.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nemet made his first appearance in [[1980]]'s ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]'',<ref name="ESB storybook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''</ref> simultaneous with the [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]]<ref name="ESB novel" /> of the film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] released later the same year. In the film, the character was only credited as one of the "Other [[Officer/Legends|Officers]],"<ref name="ESB" /> portrayed by [[Mark Jones]].<ref name="SWAuthentics">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsauthentics.com/iSynApp/productDisplay.action?productId=1325533|text=Commander Nemet|work=[https://www.starwarsauthentics.com ''Star Wars Authentics'']|archivedate=20200506234920}}</ref> Actor [[James Gleason]] dubbed over Nemet's lines at [[Wikipedia:Samuel Goldwyn Studio|Samuel Goldwyn Studios]] on [[November 2]], [[1979]], with the dialogue replacement cue sheet refering to Nemet as the "Floor Commander."<ref name="Collector">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collectors.com/autograph/star-wars-james-gleason-signed-commander-nemet-cue-sheet-8x/-8280759668287779545|text=Star Wars- James Gleason signed Commander Nemet cue sheet 8x10|work=[https://www.collectors.com collectors.com]|archivedate=20210929063842}}</ref> Toward the end of the film, footage from the ''Avenger'' scene was reused during the ''Executor''{{'s}} attempt to capture the ''Millennium Falcon'' following its escape from the Imperial-[[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Because of that, Mark Jones and other extras portraying the command crew of the ''Avenger'' are visible during that scene aboard the ''Executor''.<ref name="ESB" />

In [[1997]], Nemet was first given a name and brief backstory in a card for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]{{'s}} "[[Dagobah Limited]]" expansion set.<ref name="CCG" />

===Inconsistencies===
{{Quote|Captain&hellip;! I-It's gone! Doesn't appear on any of our tracking scopes. Perhaps they went into light-speed at the last instant&hellip;|A different version of Nemet's film lines from the comic ''Star Wars'' (1977) 42|<ref name="Marvel">[[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]]</ref>}}
In several adaptations of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', Nemet's lines regarding the ''Millennium Falcon'' differ from the film.<ref name="ESB novel" /><ref name="ESB storybook" /><ref name="Marvel" /> In the novelization, in addition to having a different line, his dialogue with Needa is expanded to him also suggesting the only logical explanation was that the ''Falcon'' went into light-speed, which contradicts with what is seen in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' film.<ref name="ESB novel" /> A similar line about the freighter going into light-speed is given to him in ''[[Marvel Comics]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]].<ref name="Marvel" /> The film's [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] also indicates that Needa turned and gave Nemet the order to track the ''Millennium Falcon'' immediately after its maneuver against the ''Avenger'';<ref name="junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> however the film shows Needa speaking with his [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Avenger)/Legends|first officer]].<ref name="ESB" /> Additionally, the novelization, ''Storybook'', and Marvel [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] have the line "We're going to collide!" as the ''Millennium Falcon'' charges the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge, though each adaptation assigns it to a different character. While the novelization presents Commander Nemet as having the line, the ''Storybook'' gives the line to Captain Needa himself, and the comic depicts Needa's first officer as the speaker.<ref name="ESB novel" /><ref name="ESB storybook" /><ref name="Marvel" /> This article assumes Nemet having the line in the novelization is the [[canon]] version of events.
